name: Railway
summary: Railway is a deployment platform that runs services from a GitHub repo, a Docker image or a template, alongside managed databases, volumes and cron jobs. Usage is billed per second for CPU, memory and storage on top of a small plan fee, and services can be set to sleep when idle (Serverless). It suits always-on agent processes that need a server, a database and little ops work.
facts: GitHub, Docker image, CLI or template
Hobby $5/mo, Pro $20/mo per workspace, plus usage
About $20 per vCPU-month and $10 per GB-month of RAM
goodFor: Always-on agent servers with a database
Quick deploys from a repo or template
watchOut: Oct 2026 security incident exposed some customer environment variables
Usage-based bills grow with always-on services
Less low-level control than raw VMs
